# ACME Bank Payment

Creates and observes an illustrative ACME bank Payment Instruction. Bank Payment Setup selects bank confirmation, adds the bank method clause and retains the shared active-context, amount, participant and instruction-identity checks. The amount binding defaults to `/product/totalMinor`, and instruction placement to `/payment`.

Authorization, capture and refund requests are distinct from the bank's external execution and recorded confirmations. Named request connections execute in the instruction, whose own guarantor operations establish acceptance and outcomes.

Configuration references: `bindings.amount` defaults to `/product/totalMinor`; `bindings.instruction` defaults to `/payment`.
